title: Preserve both distinct generators and the real safe-domain condition
statement: The source separately treats kappa sum D[Q_f P_a] and kappa sum(D[Q_f P_a]+D[I-P_a]); their coherence dynamics differ. Syndrome-pattern corner writes h(A_f tensor B_f+A_f^dagger tensor B_f^dagger), ||B_f||<=1, preserve anchored Young shapes until extent escape. Shared bath blocks need not commute or reset, and overlapping X/Z physical writes retain actual anticommutation phases. Inside the safe subspace, actual native pair correction erodes every southwest corner; safe jumps have no loss. The analytic compressed comparison is CPTP on P and factors as logical identity tensor syndrome/bath evolution under the SAME fixed decoder. P is an analytical projection,not a physical monitor or an assertion of equality to full dynamics. H_extP=0 is essential.
